rows.refusal: shell1 (hollow): the top face of turn1 could not be found on the part as it is now, so shell1 is shown without it -- open a different face, or hollow before drafting.
shell1 (hollow): it needs move1, which could not be built, so shell1 is shown without it.
shell1 (hollow): the top face of mirror1 could not be found on the part as it is now, so shell1 is shown without it -- open a different face, or hollow before drafting.

Hollowing join1 is not supported yet because the part has inside corners (a join) where the new wall would come out thicker than 1, so shell1 is shown without it -- hollow the plain shape first, or leave the hollow out.
shell1 (hollow): "side" is the curved wall of a cylinder, not a flat face, so shell1 is shown without it -- open top or bottom instead.
shell1 (hollow): a cylinder only has flat top and bottom faces, not a right one to open, so shell1 is shown without it -- use open:'top' or open:'bottom'.

draft1 (draft): the top face is square to the pull direction (z), so it cannot be tilted, and draft1 is shown without it -- draft a side face, or set from: to left, right, front or back so the pull no longer points along the top face.
